title: Time A to B
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be 1.1 s (or equivalent).

title: Max ascent distance
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be 1.25 m (or equivalent).

title: Condition and time C to D
description: Essential: The final answers for part (3) must state v_CD ≥ 4 m/s and a minimum time of 1.16 s (or equivalent).

title: Kinematics on AB
description: Important: The solution must correctly calculate the acceleration (5 m/s²) and the time/distance to reach belt speed on the horizontal section.

title: Forces on stationary CD
description: Important: For part (2), the solution must correctly apply Newton's second law to find the deceleration (10 m/s²) up the incline with friction.

title: Forces on moving CD
description: Important: For part (3), the solution must correctly analyze the two acceleration phases on the moving incline (relative motion and matching speed).

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall: Incorrect sign for acceleration on the incline (e.g., confusing up-slope and down-slope directions or friction direction).

title: Relative motion oversight
description: Pitfall: Failing to consider that the bag's initial motion relative to the moving CD belt determines the net acceleration phase.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The solution maintains consistent use of SI units (m, s, m/s, m/s²) throughout the calculation.
